absolute-path.json.reason: paths are repo-relative and must not start with /

context-length-mismatch.json.reason: when omitted is absent, len(context.lines) must equal the range size

context-without-range.json.reason: range is required whenever context is present (dependentRequired)

dotdot-path.json.reason: paths must not contain . or .. segments

empty-lines-array.json.reason: context.lines is never empty; a range spans at least one line

line-too-long.json.reason: stored lines are truncated to 1000 code points before storage

line-with-lf.json.reason: stored lines never contain LF; splitting happens before storage

line-zero.json.reason: line numbers are 1-based; start must be >= 1

long-range-missing-omitted.json.reason: a 65-line range with 64 stored lines must carry omitted = 1

long-range-not-elided.json.reason: ranges over 64 lines must be elided; context.lines holds at most 64 entries

missing-blob.json.reason: side anchors require commit, path, and blob

missing-context-lines.json.reason: context requires before, lines, and after

mixed-oid-lengths.json.reason: all OIDs within one anchor must use the same length; the containing repo has one object format

no-sides.json.reason: at least one of old/new is required

odd-length-oid.json.reason: OIDs are exactly 40 or 64 hex characters

omitted-arithmetic-wrong.json.reason: omitted must equal (end - start + 1) - 64; a 100-line range omits 36

omitted-with-short-lines.json.reason: when omitted is present, context.lines must hold exactly 64 entries (first 32 + last 32)

range-without-context.json.reason: context is required whenever range is present (dependentRequired)

trailing-slash-path.json.reason: paths must not contain empty segments (no trailing slash)

unsupported-version.json.reason: the v1 schema validates version 1 exactly; readers treat other versions as opaque but preserved, per spec/anchors.md 'Versioning and evolution'
